description: Deterministic, fail-closed transformation from canonical Maty constructors to the Zig runtime document.

runtimeDocument.role: role whose local session is executed
runtimeDocument.events: ordered array of { action, peer, label, payload }

actions.send: allowed only when current node kind is select
actions.receive: allowed only when current node kind is offer

invariants: A failed stage prevents all dependent stages from running.
The runtime document is JSON and contains named constructor kinds, never algebraic session symbols.
Every event must match the current peer, action direction, label, and payload type.
A valid event advances the cursor to the branch continuation exactly once.
